description: Create the voice recording, AI analysis, and real-time feedback system. This includes the recording UI, Whisper API integration for transcription, tajweed error analysis logic, and the feedback display with color-coded error highlights.
steps: Create recording screen in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/screens/recording/: RecordingScreen.kt (shows the target Arabic text to read, record button with animation, recording timer, stop/analyze button), RecordingViewModel.kt (manages recording state, audio file, API calls, analysis results)

Create the analysis/feedback screen in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/screens/recording/: FeedbackScreen.kt (displays original text with color-coded tajweed errors highlighted, overall score, list of specific errors with rule references, suggestion to re-record or move to next), FeedbackViewModel.kt

Create the Tajweed analysis engine in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/domain/: TajweedAnalysisUseCase.kt (orchestrates the flow: send audio to Whisper -> get transcription -> compare with expected -> identify tajweed violations), TajweedError.kt (data class with errorType, position, expected, actual, ruleName, severity), AnalysisResult.kt (score, errors list, suggestions)

Create practice mode screens in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/screens/practice/: PracticeScreen.kt (shows a specific rule, example text, instructions, record button for practice), PracticeListScreen.kt (list of available practice exercises per rule), PracticeViewModel.kt (manages practice session, tracks attempts and scores)

Create recording animation components in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/components/: RecordingButton.kt (animated pulsing microphone button), WaveformVisualizer.kt (shows audio waveform during recording), ScoreCircle.kt (animated circular progress showing score)
Create permission handling in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/components/PermissionHandler.kt - request RECORD_AUDIO permission with rationale dialog
acceptance_criteria: Recording screen shows target text and provides record/stop controls
RecordingViewModel manages MediaRecorder lifecycle and audio file storage
WhisperApiService is called with the recorded audio file for transcription
TajweedAnalysisUseCase compares transcription against expected text and identifies errors
Feedback screen color-codes the Arabic text (green for correct, red for errors, yellow for warnings)
Each error shows which tajweed rule was violated and how to fix it
Practice mode allows focused practice on individual rules
Recording button has a visual pulsing animation while recording
Audio permission is requested properly with rationale
verification: Verify RecordingViewModel handles recording states (Idle, Recording, Processing, Done)
Verify TajweedAnalysisUseCase produces TajweedError objects with rule references
Verify FeedbackScreen renders errors with color coding
Verify practice mode connects to specific rules and tracks scores
findings: Added material-icons-extended dependency for icons used across recording/practice screens. Made TajweedAnalyzer injectable with @Inject and @Singleton. Updated RecordingResultDao.insert to return Long (the generated ID) so RecordingViewModel can pass it to FeedbackScreen. Added getById to RecordingRepository interface and implementation. All user-facing text in Uzbek. NavGraph now uses actual screen composables instead of placeholders for Recording, Feedback, Practice, and PracticeSession routes.
